content: Before initiating direct-acting antiviral (DAA) therapy for hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection, it is essential to test for hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection. This includes evaluating markers such as hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), hepatitis B e antigen (HBeAg), and HBV DNA levels to determine whether treatment for HBV is indicated. After completing DAA therapy, it is critical to maintain vigilant monitoring for potential complications, including the development of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).
